funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage with a confirmed publisher and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues or articles reflecting advanced research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any career stage (up to £3,000 and £3,001‑£8,000) and post‑doctoral level or equivalent (up to £20,000). Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible funding to support research travel and/or research time for projects in British art, visual culture and architecture.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Students enrolled to start or already undertaking a master's or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Fixed‑amount funding to help students begin or continue their postgraduate studies in the field of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) from any country researching eighteenth‑ and nineteenth‑century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support research trips to examine historic works on paper such as prints, drawings and watercolours.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: £32,000 total (one year, or split over two years for part‑time)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK master’s degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) beginning between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master’s level degree that will bring new perspectives to the understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK doctoral programme starting between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a doctoral research project that expands understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 for one year or £70,000 for two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Post‑doctoral level researchers (or equivalent experience) and above.
opportunities.summary: Funding to undertake a major research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree (pre‑doctoral to internationally recognised experts).
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome providing board, accommodation and an honorarium for research on British‑Italian cultural exchange.
